presentation.label: CTRL ALL
presentation.summary: Hold TRK and turn a knob on a sound or TRIG page: the same step goes to that parameter on all twelve sound tracks.
presentation.overview: Ctrl All turns TRK into an all-tracks modifier. Hold TRK and turn a knob on a sound page (SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP, LFO) or the TRIG page, and the same step goes to that parameter on all twelve sound tracks, so their differences are kept and each track stops at its own limits. On the SYNTH page each track moves the parameter under the same knob of its own machine's page. FILTER TYP sets every track to the type the selected track reaches. With the FX track selected, while a trig key is held, or on FX and global pages, the knob behaves as stock. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0014-ctrl-all 1.2, with his code unchanged.
highlights: TRK + knob moves one parameter on all twelve sound tracks.
The step is relative, so the tracks keep their differences.
SYNTH knobs pair by their place on each machine's page.
Stock behaviour on the FX track, with a trig key held, and on FX or global pages.
usage: Use a build containing Ctrl All. Open the FILTER page and note FRQ on two tracks.
On one track, hold TRK and turn FRQ (knob E). Select the other track: its FRQ moved by the same amount.
On the SYNTH page, hold TRK and turn a knob: each track moves the parameter under that knob on its own machine's page.
Release TRK, select the FX track, or hold a trig key while turning: only the selected track changes, as on stock.

access.location: Any sound page (SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP, LFO) or the TRIG page, while TRK is held.
steps: Select a sound track and open a sound page or the TRIG page.
Hold TRK and turn a knob.

controls.name: TRK + any knob
controls.doc: On a sound page or the TRIG page, applies the turn to that parameter on all twelve sound tracks; FILTER TYP sets every track to the selected track's new type.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
On the SYNTH page a track whose machine has no parameter under the turned knob is left alone.
FILTER TYP is set, not stepped: every track takes the type the selected track reaches.
With a trig key held the turn stays on one track, so parameter locks are never spread.
Parameters that other modules add stay single-track unless that module handles TRK itself.

claims: ui:TRK + knob on sound and TRIG pages

load.display: None in the audio path: runs only when a knob is turned
load.conditions: Static: the one site is in param_apply_delta, the routine that applies a knob turn; with TRK held it calls each track's delta handler twelve times instead of once. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, ctrl-all 1.2 passed its four tests (FILTER FRQ, SYNTH knobs across BD HARD and SD HARD, FILTER TYP, FX track and trig key) in R8K4 (2026-10-19), and its own test again with core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods ports in C3A4 (2026-10-20). On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24) TRK + FRQ moved several tracks together and the FX track changed alone, and a four-minute play showed no freeze or dropout. Alone on CAH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) TRK + FRQ moved several tracks together and the FX track changed alone.
limitations: Tested builds: R8K4, .syx 4f54db92ed3955be1be32123f6cb51c8ebd081936dead60130111f46fba329b8; C3A4, .syx 04d987ced36850eef5eb5cd1215d411edf621a5af94f980525ab561c9108f951. Firmware was not read back from the device.

SXH4 (the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-24/25, .syx e4d01a6aec250bd2af7743c9f8b0e9c560d805b52564932dddc41d872e1c5000) also carried a remote-control test layer that shares no site with core or the modules. CAH4 (alone with the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-25, .syx 7c09272dc47d3a3c51d759d931d739f81c7893e6ec4eea894164c6b0166f1f16) carried the same test layer.

tests.summary: Hardware: ctrl-all 1.2's four tests pass on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74 (R8K4, 2026-10-19; C3A4 with core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-20). Modwerk's source build gives a main OS byte-identical to elekloader's build of the rytm2_mods v1.2 release. In rytm-emu, SD's FRQ follows a TRK + FRQ turn on BD, where stock leaves it.

steps: Use a build containing Ctrl All. Open the FILTER page and note FRQ on two tracks.
